verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.blaxel.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured docs index. The docs are also served as raw .md pages (e.g. Overview.md, Sandboxes/MCP.md), and Blaxel ships installable agent skills, including an open-source migration skill, that give agents product knowledge. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, and no independent or hands-on report of agents actually consuming these docs.
